recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5947 in core source unless a separate issue is opened to revise broader ValueSet expansion wording or CodeSystem hierarchy policy.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 ValueSet issue requesting removal of wording that equated child concepts with subsumption/is-a and replacement with guidance that parent/child meaning is not fixed and may include partitive or categorization relationships.
initial_application: The issue was directly applied in svn revision 5884, now git commit 4d58ba423fb6e247c224c0ad6967c2fdf863059e, in source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml. Later #10309 removed inline code systems from ValueSet, and FHIR-10542 corrected the successor CodeSystem.concept.concept definition to point to hierarchyMeaning.
additional_context: ValueSet and CodeSystem are active build resources. Current CodeSystem source defines hierarchyMeaning, states CodeSystem.concept.concept relationships are variable and should be understood via hierarchyMeaning, and defines subsumption relative to that hierarchy meaning. Later FHIR-25983 and FHIR-39262 refined the same model with hierarchyMeaning warning invariants and nested/property hierarchy clarification. Current ValueSet expansion hierarchy text is separately non-inferential and does not reintroduce the old code-system child-is-a assertion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current R6-era source preserves the seed issue's semantics in the modern CodeSystem model rather than the obsolete ValueSet.define inline code system structure.

related_jiras.note: Later Published CodeSystem issue corrected CodeSystem.concept.concept to refer to hierarchyMeaning after inline code systems moved out of ValueSet.
Later Published issue added warning invariants encouraging hierarchyMeaning when CodeSystem hierarchies are present; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published issue clarified nested concepts and property-based polyhierarchies without reverting the seed's non-is-a assumption.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification ValueSet issue asking to clarify that child concepts are not necessarily subsumed/is-a relationships and may be partitive or categorization relationships.
evidence_items.learned: The issue is final WG intent to remove the old universal subsumption assumption for child concepts.

evidence_items.summary: The 2015 #5947 commit replaced the ValueSet note saying contained concepts are subsumed/is-a with text saying the relationship is not fixed and can be partitive or categorization-based.
evidence_items.learned: The seed issue was directly applied in the historical ValueSet source.

evidence_items.summary: The 2016 #10309 refactor removed inline code systems from ValueSet, and the 2016 #10542 fix changed CodeSystem.concept.concept to refer to hierarchyMeaning.
evidence_items.learned: The modern source location for the seed semantics is the CodeSystem hierarchy model, not ValueSet.define.

evidence_items.summary: CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning defines concept hierarchy meaning, and CodeSystem.concept.concept says child relationships are variable and points to hierarchyMeaning.
evidence_items.learned: The current conformance source avoids the old assumption that all child concepts are is-a/subsumption relationships.

evidence_items.summary: The CodeSystem narrative describes nested concepts, property-based polyhierarchies, and subsumption in relation to CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning.
evidence_items.learned: Current narrative refines the seed clarification while preserving non-fixed hierarchy semantics.

evidence_items.summary: ValueSet expansion hierarchy text says nested contains elements have no logical relationship implication and cannot be used for inferencing.
evidence_items.learned: Current ValueSet text does not reintroduce the old code-system child-is-a assertion.
